population_estimate.reason: WITHDRAWN: previous estimate 341,555 was based on assumed GFA split and densities that are not derived from approved planning inputs. A defensible population estimate requires: (a) approved statutory land-use plan, (b) approved buildable GFA per parcel, (c) approved residential/commercial split, (d) approved employment density assumptions, (e) survey-based baseline population. No figure should be quoted in proposal narrative until these inputs are available.
population_estimate.note: DATA GAP — no defensible population figure can be produced from public sources at this stage.

retain_renovate_demolish_breakdown.reason: WITHDRAWN: previously reported as retain 0% / renovate 35% / demolish 8% / new build 57%. The '0% retain' was a derived concept from limited illustrative footprints and is NOT a heritage retention figure. Heritage retention and demolition decisions require: (a) approved statutory heritage register, (b) approved structural-condition survey, (c) parcel-level land-use plan.
retain_renovate_demolish_breakdown.note: DATA GAP — heritage and structural condition data are not yet integrated. Concept bands shown for spatial logic illustration only.

renewable_energy_target.reason: WITHDRAWN as a 30% commitment; presented as concept target band. Renewable energy ratio cannot be fixed without approved district energy strategy, building energy code and grid-interconnection study.
renewable_energy_target.note: Concept target band only; not an engineering commitment.

talent_apartment_ratio.reason: WITHDRAWN as a 15% commitment; presented as concept target band. Talent apartment ratio cannot be fixed without approved housing-strategy and demographic baseline.

apm_light_rail_addition.reason: WITHDRAWN — internal APM or light-rail addition cannot be proposed without rail-authority consultation, alignment study and ridership forecast. Any new rail alignment must follow the official rail-authority process and is OUT of scope for an agent concept proposal. Use existing lines 13 / 15 / Changping South Extension as design references only.
apm_light_rail_addition.note: DATA GAP / OUT-OF-SCOPE — APM/light rail addition removed from concept recommendations.
